The discrepancy between references to "Mesa" and "Chandler" created confusion, which the agent did not resolve effectively. The agent also exhibited repetitive behavior, repeatedly searching the same query without drawing on richer, more reliable sources. This initial mistake cascaded through subsequent steps, causing the conversation to enter a loop of redundant actions without producing a definitive and well-supported answer.
